experiment.claim: Issue #4 -- characterizes sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68 (small unit) and sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W3p40L3p40 (large unit) VEB vs collector current (100nA..100uA, half-decade steps) and vs temperature/process corner, plus the PTAT dVBE between the two emitter sizes at matched current. Informs the usable current-density window / effective ideality factor for spec/topology-survey.md and the amplifier offset budget (#9). Supply axis intentionally fixed at nominal 3.30V: both devices are diode-connected (base=collector=0) and biased by ideal DC current sources with no supply-referenced terminal in the DUT, so sweeping supply would not change any result -- see design/device-characterization-summary.md.
experiment.statistical_convention: N/A (corner-matrix / bias-ladder characterization, not a distribution claim)
